            pa</rs> dang | sna sogs mngon pa kun las btus pa zhes pa 2 las snang tshogs <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">mngon pa kun las
            btus pa</rs> nas slob dpon rtogs pa'i seng ges gdod || <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="14b9"/> zhes tshig drangs pa na
            'grel pa'i tshig du byung ni snang ste rnaM par mi rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan lo ka las 'das
            pa'i ye+es dang de'i rjes pas thob pa yin zhes pa ni | rtogs pa'i seng ge nyid gyis shes
            rab logs su bskyed par bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa yin gyi <rs type="work">rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa</rs> las de
            ltar mi 'dod do zhes bshad pas 'grel pa 'di rtogs pa'i seng ge zhes bya bas mdzad pa
            <expan>yin no</expan> || zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4261">mchims</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> 2 ka zer ro || </seg></TEI>
